failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 5, Ink second and rule 1; Part IV B6; brand/ledger.md A2
failures.place: Left screen, offer field: 'Listed at $45' and 'Offer ends tomorrow, 6 pm'.
failures.issue: Both lines use gray secondary text on the colored field. Secondary ink is restricted to white and gray grounds; text on the field must be black. This fails regardless of whether the gray happens to meet a minimum contrast ratio.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 4 C1; Part IV B3; brand/ledger.md L3
failures.issue: The wordmarks sit visibly right of the screen centers. The left screen spans approximately x102–618, with center x360, while its wordmark centers near x374; the right screen repeats the offset. This exceeds B3's ±1 px centering tolerance.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 7.6; Part III App canvas; Part IV B28
failures.place: Both complete phone views, from status bar through home indicator.
failures.issue: Each phone view occupies approximately 516 × 1024 pixels. At 390 pixels wide it is about 774 pixels high, rather than the required 844. This board therefore cannot establish the requested density at the prescribed phone size.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 6.2 and Roles; Part IV B14; brand/ledger.md A3 and D6
failures.issue: The peak amount is visibly undersized for the required 50-point role. At the depicted screen width, its apparent text size is around the 36-point step. Every listed D6 option retains size 50; D3 does not reopen that size. This is a visual size finding, not a claim about a source font declaration.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 5, Ink second and rule 1; Part IV B6; brand/ledger.md A2
failures.place: Left screen, offer field: 'Listed at $45' and the expiry line.
failures.issue: Both lines are gray on the colored field. The rules require black text on field fills and restrict secondary gray ink to white or gray grounds.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 4 C1; Part IV B3; brand/ledger.md L3
failures.issue: Both wordmarks are approximately 14 board pixels right of their respective screen centers, outside the ±1 px tolerance.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 7.6; Part III App canvas; Part IV B28
failures.issue: The approximately 516 × 1024 phone views become 390 × 774 when scaled uniformly to the required width. They do not preserve the required 390 × 844 canvas, so the visible content fit is not a valid true-scale spacing comparison.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 6.2 and Roles; Part IV B14; brand/ledger.md A3 and D6
failures.issue: The peak amount appears around the 36-point step when judged relative to the screen width, rather than the 50-point size retained by all D6 options. Exact font metrics cannot be recovered from this raster, but the displayed role is visibly too small.

failures.place: Left screen, gap between the offer expiry line and Accept/Counter controls.
failures.issue: The roughly 44-pixel gap within the offer exceeds the roughly 40-pixel separation between the field's bottom and the next item's photo. The offer's internal separation is larger than its separation from the neighboring item, reversing the required grouping hierarchy.

failures.issue: The secondary lines use gray ink on a field fill, where black text is required.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 4 C1; Part IV B3; brand/ledger.md L3
failures.issue: Both wordmarks sit approximately 14 board pixels right of the screen centers, exceeding the ±1 px centering tolerance.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 7.6; Part III App canvas; Part IV B28
failures.issue: The phone views are approximately 516 × 1024 pixels, equivalent to 390 × 774 at the prescribed width, not 390 × 844. The apparent fit and crowding are therefore shown on the wrong canvas proportions.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Article 6.2 and Roles; Part IV B14; brand/ledger.md A3 and D6
failures.issue: Relative to screen width, the peak amount appears near the 36-point step rather than the required 50-point sale amount. D3 permits spacing changes; none of the D6 choices permits this smaller peak amount. Exact font declarations are not available from the image.

failures.place: Both screens, Brass lamp row directly above the fixed bottom navigation.
failures.issue: The lamp photo and Continue/Edit/More controls reach the navigation's top boundary with essentially no separation. The airy gaps higher on the screen end in a collision between the final item's controls and a different navigation group. The static board does not demonstrate that scrolling can restore clearance.

across_options.issue: Photo dimensions and aspect ratios change, beyond D3 spacing (brand/ledger.md D3; brand/constitution.md Article 14.4). The Nike image is approximately 144 × 116 pixels in A versus 144 × 132 in B and C. The lamp image is approximately 144 × 118 in A versus 144 × 138 in B and 144 × 134 in C. This changes image prominence and content fit independently of gaps.

The item photography is not held constant (brand/constitution.md Article 14.4; brand/ledger.md D3). The jacket's drape and hem, the shoe arrangement/crop, and the lamp's framing visibly differ. These are image-content changes, not spacing changes, and affect the comparison's visual balance.

The offer field's mesh-line pattern and color distribution change with its dimensions (brand/ledger.md D3 versus D5; brand/constitution.md Article 14.4). A has a denser, shallower fan of curves; B and C show a taller, more vertical sweep. Field texture is a separate open decision, so these boards also vary the field's visual treatment.
